stem:
The diagram shows a closed shape drawn on Sana's slate, with vertices labelled A, B, C and D.

Which claim about the figure is correct?

options.text: The figure is a quadrilateral: it has four straight sides.
The figure is a triangle: it has three straight sides.
The figure is a circle: its side is a single curve.
The figure is a five-sided polygon: it has five straight sides.

teacher.key_rationale: ABCD has four straight sides, so it is a quadrilateral. Calling it a triangle swaps the side count. Calling it a circle treats a straight-sided figure as curved. Calling it five-sided miscounts the sides.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote right-triangle source into quadrilateral ABCD; stem refers to the diagram.
